entry.title: llama.cpp b12706 released
entry.summary: metal : reserve the top-k scratch only for short rows ( #32942 ) The bitonic top-k path is only faster for short rows. On M5 and M2 Ultra it wins up to 128 columns; above that the radix path is faster. Use the radix path for ncols > 128. The radix path selects in place and needs no scratch, but the buffer type always r — Also covered by: ggml-org/whisper.cpp
